install: export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"; export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"; if ! command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ "$(bun --version)" != "1.3.9" ]; then curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash -s bun-v1.3.9; fi; sudo ln -sf "$BUN_INSTALL/bin/bun" /usr/local/bin/bun 2>/dev/null || true; bun install --frozen-lockfile
